candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order POST ReadTimeout, 503 on /v1/orders, and 502 on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or DB logs; pool exhaustion inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5, idle 0, DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, propagating as order ReadTimeout, 503 /v1/orders, and 502 /v1/checkout. Inventory and payment succeed. Gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with ~2.4s p95. Consistent with db-pool-exhaustion.
